document_title: Order Adopting Stipulation - Georgia Power Company's 2025 Integrated Resource Plan and 2025 DSM Plan
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=223496 to read its download link. The PDF rendition of this order (fileId 104726, '223496(f).pdf') is a scanned image with no usable text layer, so I downloaded the DOCX rendition the Commission published alongside it, from https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/223496/104728. Converted it by reading word/document.xml out of the DOCX zip with Python zipfile + ElementTree, emitting one line per <w:p> paragraph, mapping <w:tab> to a tab and <w:br>/<w:cr> to a newline. No other cleanup: tabs, blank paragraphs and the Commission letterhead block are exactly as stored in the file.
